event.detail:
Reviewed commit: 1ed482dde220452e424973faf38a5e1318986333

## TLDR
Upgrading ends programs in old tmux terminals and loses their retained terminal contents; removing this output/replay path also prevents those contents from being viewed afterward. This is explicitly accepted product behavior, so this record proposes dropping the concern subject to the caller's independent check.

## Details
Assigned patch 00957-001.patch:1-1205 deletes next_output, paused replay, safe shutdown/reaper handling and associated tests from crates/farhelm-supervisor/src/tmux/stream.rs. At this point the pinned SPEC.md:3003-3016 explicitly retires old terminals: "This release ends them: the first time a host's supervisor of this release starts, it ends that tmux server, and with it everything that still ran in an old terminal, without needing a tmux program." It also states: "one whose agent had already ended keeps its outcome, but its terminal's last screen, which lived in the server, is gone; old tabs are closed." And: "After an update to this release, Restart, Clone and Replace start such a session in a new, empty terminal." Thus preserving the retired stream's decoding and replay behavior would not preserve terminal contents after the specified startup retirement. Suggested bucket: highest (loss of user-owned processes and terminal contents), if contrary to the accepted retirement contract. Confidence: confirmed specification acceptance; replacement/startup implementation still to be checked in the initial pass. Could-be-highest: yes, explicitly. proposed_drop: exact specification acceptance quoted above, SPEC.md at reviewed revision, Terminal experience. possible_cover: none; coverage sources were not searched. Source-only conclusion; no runtime execution or reproduction. Caveat: this acceptance does not excuse affecting terminals already running in terminal hosts; that exclusion is still being checked.

Also: "one whose agent had already ended keeps its outcome, but its terminal's last screen, which lived in the server, is gone; old tabs are closed." Also: "After an update to this release, Restart, Clone and Replace start such a session in a new, empty terminal." event.summary: Removed query stripping does not leave a second terminal interpreter
event.detail:
Reviewed commit: 1ed482dde220452e424973faf38a5e1318986333

## TLDR
Considered whether removing tmux's query stripping would send terminal queries to a browser that answers them a second time, injecting duplicate replies into an agent or shell. The remaining path interprets output once in the supervisor and sends rendered grids to viewers.

## Details
Assigned patch 00957-001.patch:85-148 removes decoding and ordinary-query stripping from next_output. This boundary existed because tmux interpreted ordinary queries while passthrough queries needed the browser. At the reviewed revision service/terminals.rs:125-153 and 232-255 resolve only HostTerminal values; service/handlers.rs:1688-1715 refuses non-grid clients, and :1928-1958 always builds StreamKind::Grid with a GridStream backed by that host. hosts/terminal.rs:3343-3370 routes journal output to on_output, :3424-3507 feeds its emulator, and :3250-3295 sends the emulator's query answers through bounded pending input. SPEC_impl.md:2767-2802 states: "the supervisor's emulator is the one place its output is interpreted" and describes its answer table. The raw tmux/browser double-interpreter premise is absent after deletion; this is a source refutation, not acceptance of duplicate replies. Suggested bucket if established: high/material terminal UX; no established security or loss-of-work route. Could-be-highest: no established route; duplicate terminal responses alone do not establish a command or loss-of-work consequence. Confidence: confirmed source refutation. proposed_drop: source refutation above. possible_cover: none; coverage sources were not searched. Source-only analysis; no behavior was reproduced. Caveat: this does not review the emulator's entire answer table or independent pre-existing bugs in the grid path.

event.summary: Proposed drop: host output has one query interpreter across replay and attach
event.detail:
Reviewed commit: 1ed482dde220452e424973faf38a5e1318986333

## TLDR
Original suspected consequence preserved: deleting query stripping might inject duplicate terminal replies into agents or shells. The replacement sends grids to viewers and keeps query interpretation in the supervisor, including during journal recovery. No drop has been accepted.

## Details
Turn-2 synthesis revision after raw evidence delivery of the full assigned patch. Patch 00957-001.patch:85-148 removes ordinary-query stripping that avoided tmux/browser duplicate answers and bypassed stripping for tmux passthrough wrappers. service/terminals.rs:125-153,232-255 resolves only HostTerminal, and service/handlers.rs:1688-1715 refuses non-grid clients; :1928-1958 always creates a Grid stream over the existing runtime. Browser viewers get screen/history cells, not an escape stream needing its own terminal-query answer path.

Replacement lifecycle checks: hosts/terminal.rs:1740-1930 adopts exactly one owning host connection (a recovered host uses the scan's existing connection); :1818-1843 determines fresh versus recovered replay boundaries from delivered_end. :2728-2773 chooses Live/ReplaySeen/ReplayUnseen per journal position. :3424-3507 skips bytes below the already-processed position, splits recovery at seen_end and the adoption end, and feeds only the relevant region once. :3519-3568 flushes an open synchronized update with the proper replay effects and feeds live bytes; :3973-4005 completes replay without turning its held effects live. farhelm-terminal-emulator/src/effects.rs:199-214 drops every effect in ReplaySeen, allows replies but no clipboard/bell/title effects in ReplayUnseen, and delivers live effects normally. hosts/terminal.rs:3250-3295 queues the resulting replies in the bounded host input path. On runtime reconnect, :4171-4190 restarts reading at the processed position, not at the journal start. Attaching another viewer therefore does not re-feed the journal or add a second query interpreter.

Contract: SPEC_impl.md:2767-2802 says "the supervisor's emulator is the one place its output is interpreted" and assigns it query replies; :2129-2164 specifies seen/unseen replay effects and accepted delivery ambiguity. That delivery ambiguity may leave a previously delivered query unanswered after supervisor failure; it is not evidence of duplicate replies and is not the reason to exclude the deletion concern.

Suggested bucket if established: high/material terminal UX. Could-be-highest: no established command-execution or loss-of-work route from duplicate replies; if such a route were supplied it must be assessed separately, not discounted for rarity. Confidence: confirmed source refutation of the deletion's double-interpreter premise. proposed_drop: host/grid plus seen/unseen replay source chain above. possible_cover: none; forbidden coverage sources not searched. No unresolved concrete lead for this route. Caveat: this is not a full correctness review of every emulator answer or protocol parser. Source-only analysis; no runtime behavior was reproduced.
